sql:
SELECT
  metabolism.met_id,
  metabolism.met_conversion,
  metabolism.pathway_key,
  metabolism.enzyme_name,
  substrate.compound_name AS substrate_name,
  parent.compound_name AS parent_name,
  substrate_struct.canonical_smiles
FROM metabolism
JOIN compound_records AS substrate ON metabolism.substrate_record_id = substrate.record_id
JOIN compound_records AS parent ON metabolism.drug_record_id = parent.record_id
JOIN compound_structures AS substrate_struct ON substrate.molregno = substrate_struct.molregno
WHERE metabolism.tax_id = 9481
ORDER BY metabolism.met_id ASC
LIMIT 200;
